title: Hon son of Rav Nachman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Yevamot 34a, where he raised a difficulty to Rav Nachman, and there at 112a, where he asked Rav Nachman a question. See the entry Huna son of Rav Nachman.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading form is Hon; the cross-reference form is Huna. The second question is asked of Rav Nachman, not by him.

The whole Davidson Yevamot 112a paragraph has Hun son of Rav Nachman asking Rav Nachman, supporting the local full title and question direction. The selected Yevamot 34a paragraphs instead have Rav Nachman reporting Rabbah bar Avuh and Rava addressing Rav Nachman; they do not by themselves substantiate Hyman’s first attribution, and no whole-page absence is claimed. His first account remains attributed; Hon/Hun and the separate Huna cross-reference are not harmonized into an identity.
